description: Contract pin updates for a service-catalog implementation. Copy into the implementation repo and replace every __SERVICE__ with the service name and every __CATALOG_REPO__ with the catalog's owner/repo: sed -i '' -e 's/__SERVICE__/orders/g' -e 's|__CATALOG_REPO__|hungovercoders/service-catalog|g' renovate.json. One-time setup: install the Renovate app and enable 'Allow auto-merge' on the repo, with branch protection requiring the contract-converge check.
